svg.title: How a run works
svg.desc: Four lives; each hit costs one and gives one second of grace. Every 15 seconds the level goes up: one more circle, from 12 to 24, and 6 percent more speed, up to 1.6 times. A power-up appears every 9 to 15 seconds and fades after 8: Shield blocks the next hit, Slow halves the circles speed for 5 seconds, Heart gives a lost life back, never more than four.
